description: The Guishan study uses GPS-X and 2021 operating data to compare five changes to oxidation-ditch treatment at a Taiwanese plant. The combined flow, aeration and return-sludge scenario gives the strongest reported nitrogen-removal improvement. This resource is provided by Chen et al.. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for the version of record. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These are calibrated-model scenario results, not measured benefits after implementation. For simulation, it documents an application that can inform scenario design. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
